zh: 互動式段落播放器：夜城演出上線——段落字母的七種顯示形式、跑道上的 MIDI 音符與 tempo 讀數、A 段的熄燈閃電落幕，以及全新的特殊結尾「字母門」：結尾字母沿著跑道向你駛來、貼著小節線放大、穿過畫面把整個舞台收走（三種型號，看你抽到哪一種）。桌面版「設計」內開始展示。
en: Interactive Section Player: the night-city show is live — seven letter forms, MIDI notes and tempo on the road, A's blackout-and-lightning finale, and a brand-new special ending: the letter door rides the road toward you, grows on the bar lines and sweeps the whole stage away as it passes (three builds; luck of the draw). Start it under Design (desktop).

zh: 新設計上線：「四鋼琴環繞 - 非和諧不等式」——ADE 第 1 樂章《前奏》與第 2 樂章《過飽和》，前後左右四台鋼琴同時演奏，桌面就是場地、滑鼠就是你，走到哪聽到哪。在「設計」裡開始展示（桌面版）。
en: New design: Asymmetric Dissonant for Four Pianos — ADE movements I (Prelude) and II (Supersaturated). Four pianos play at once around you; the desktop is the hall and the pointer is you. Start it under Design (desktop only).

zh: 上架三首曲目：elcirtnev>、Summer -《立夏》、Rainbow -《虹》；開機隨機起播、全程隨機不重複。
en: Three tracks are up: elcirtnev>, Summer – 立夏, Rainbow – 虹. Boot picks one at random; playback shuffles without repeats.

zh: 互動式段落播放器（測試版）與 Transition 概念展示可在「互動展示」試玩。
en: The Interactive Section Player (test build) and the Transition demo are playable under Demos.
